rounded_exact_dd.role: lattice control and first-arm resource measurement

domains.baseline: centered rolling median over 480 field knots
domains.remainder: exhaustive complement; never interpreted as true rest
domains.intervals: piecewise-linear threshold crossings with half-open boundaries

eligibility.unit_scope: arm-local assigned units; no cross-arm unit matching
eligibility.rule: at least 100 outside-mask-flat events in the full W2 point dataset
eligibility.bootstrap_policy: freeze each arm's full-W2 eligible unit set for every draw

primary_statistic.name: rho_negative_vs_flat
primary_statistic.definition: Spearman correlation across eligible arm-local units between log((negative_count+0.5)/negative_exposure) and log((flat_count+0.5)/flat_exposure)
primary_statistic.interpretation: continuity proxy only; not identity or purity

bootstrap.resampling: sample whole block IDs with replacement; use identical draw multiplicities for every arm
bootstrap.exposure: sum exact domain-by-block exposure with sampled multiplicity
bootstrap.confidence_interval: 2.5 and 97.5 percentiles of valid paired delta draws

comparisons.delta_orientation: first arm rho minus second arm rho

yield.definition: number of arm-local assigned units in W2

segment_safe_short_isi.definition: fraction of within-unit, within-domain adjacent ISIs from 9 through 29 samples inclusive

decisions.meaningful_first_arm_advantage: delta_rho >= 0.05, 95% CI lower bound > 0, and directional yield/ISI guardrails pass
decisions.practical_equivalence: entire 95% delta-rho CI lies within [-0.05, 0.05] and symmetric yield/ISI guardrails pass
decisions.undefined: if either arm has fewer than 3 eligible units, a constant rank vector, a non-finite point rho, or fewer than 1900 valid bootstrap draws, report unresolved and do not substitute zero

staging.stage_0_purpose: measure one selected end-to-end arm before setting later-arm caps
staging.stage_2_trigger: launch only if the frozen stage-1 reading does not resolve whether the result is driven by field rounding versus operator choice

resources.later_arm_caps_policy: freeze after the completed rounded_exact_dd measurement and before another sort authorization
resources.stage_0_publication_failure: detection HDF5 mtime changed during symlink reuse; bounded in measurement audit
resources.later_arm_detection_reuse_policy: copy detection inputs into final-path sort; no symlink back to detection artifact
